items.name: Lifestyle Seasons Winter 2014
items.information: Car parks are available at the venue. Please DO NOT PARK on the street in the community. You're welcome to park on Sundial Boulevard if there are no car parks available.

items.name: N8W8 Summer 2014
items.information: The entrance fee for this competition will be: For competitors: €8 per day or €15 for the weekend. Competitors only registered for 3x3 get a €3 discount. There's a limit of 45 competitors.

items.name: Bergen Open 2014

venue.name: [Torgallmenningen, or Nordnes bydelshus if the weather does not cooperate.](https://goo.gl/maps/tQCiQ)

items.information: The competition is a organized as a part of the Bergen board game festival. If the weather is good, the competition will be held outside, at Torgallmenningen in Bergen. Otherwise, it will be at Nordnes Bydelshus which is nearby.

items.name: Taiwan Summer Open 2014

venue.name: [Multifunction Room, National Cheng Kung university](http://web.ncku.edu.tw/bin/home.php?Lang=en)
venue.address: Address No.1, Daxue Rd., East Dist., Tainan City 701, Taiwan (R.O.C.)
venue.details: Multifunction Room, Kuang Fu campus, follow the signs.

items.information: Registration fee is $450 NTD base (include 6 events), $10 NTD for one more event.
